correctness.rationale: Exact differentiation produces the stated r_m and Q_m recurrence. Rolle with an extra zero at y=0 for y^{r/d}Q proves yQ prime plus positive Q retains only roots in (0,1], with strict interior simplicity; roots at y=1 lose exactly one multiplicity per differentiation and Q_m(0) never vanishes. This proves all n,m,d. Hägg–Shapiro Theorem 1.4(i) then forces its connected core containing all unit-root endpoints to equal the star. The 560 exact symbolic cases are supplementary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: For the canonical symmetric regular-root polynomial, the result supplies a natural complete shape classification of a new global derivative-zero invariant, uniformly across every power and derivative order. It proves a structural contrast with general polynomials having isolated or infinitely many transient zeros and adds explicit real-root interlacing. The value does not rest on finite computations, a manufactured parameter slice, or new notation for a single classical special case.
